card.reorder_hint: Drag or use the arrows — the order is the priority.
card.reorder_failed: Could not save the new order. Check that all priority helpers exist and that their range covers the number of loads.

errors.no-source-grid: No grid sensor configured — and no Energy Manager integration found. Set a grid sensor in the editor or install the integration.
errors.no-source-split: Production or consumption sensor missing — and no Energy Manager integration found. Add the sensors in the editor or install the integration.
errors.grid-unavailable: The grid sensor is currently not reporting a value.
errors.production-unavailable: The production sensor is currently not reporting a value.
errors.consumption-unavailable: The consumption sensor is currently not reporting a value.
errors.wrong-unit: A sensor does not measure power. Expected W or kW — a kWh meter reports energy, not an instantaneous value.

warnings.device-no-power-estimate: {detail}: without a power sensor and without a rated power the indicator assumes 500 W.
warnings.min-power-above-max: {detail}: switch-on threshold is above the rated power.
warnings.no-devices: No load configured. Loads are created in the Energy Manager integration.
warnings.battery-soc-without-power: State of charge is configured but no battery power — the surplus correction has no effect.
warnings.smoothing-below-interval: The averaging window is smaller than the sampling interval and therefore has no effect.
warnings.mixed-priority-entities: Only some loads have a priority helper. The order then mixes helper values and list positions — hard to predict. Either give all of them one, or none.
warnings.reorder-without-priority-entities: Reordering from the dashboard is enabled, but not every load has a priority helper. Without it the new order would be gone after a reload.

meter_mode.label: Meter source
meter_mode.helper: Either one bidirectional grid sensor or separate consumption and production sensors.

grid_entity.label: Grid sensor
grid_entity.helper: Positive when importing, negative when exporting.

invert_grid.label: Invert sign
invert_grid.helper: Enable if the sensor reports positive values while exporting.

consumption_includes_battery.label: Consumption includes battery charging
consumption_includes_battery.helper: Enable if the consumption sensor already counts battery charging.

battery_power_entity.label: Battery power
battery_power_entity.helper: Positive when charging, negative when discharging.

battery_mode.label: Battery in surplus
battery_mode.helper: Charging power always counts as available. The question is whether discharging should reduce the surplus.

battery_charge_entity.label: Charge power
battery_charge_entity.helper: Alternative to a bidirectional sensor: two always-positive sensors.

battery_min_soc.label: Minimum state of charge
battery_min_soc.helper: Below this, charging the battery takes priority over the loads.

battery_reserve_w.label: Battery reserve
battery_reserve_w.helper: Power always kept for the battery.

smoothing_window.label: Averaging window
smoothing_window.helper: Smooths the surplus so passing clouds do not cause switching storms. 0 disables smoothing.

scale_max.label: Scale maximum
scale_max.helper: Leave empty to derive it from the rated powers.

switch_action.label: What the switch does
switch_action.helper: "Automatic" means: switch the automation as soon as a load has an `auto_entity` in YAML — otherwise the device.
switch_action.helper_integration: "Automatic" means: switch the automation, since the integration provides an automation switch per load.

allow_reorder.label: Reorder from the dashboard
allow_reorder.helper: Requires a `priority_entity` in YAML for every load. With the Energy Manager integration this is not needed.
allow_reorder.helper_integration: The integration creates a priority entity per load — reordering works without any further setup.

integration.detected: The Energy Manager integration is installed. Loads, priority and sensors are maintained there — this card only displays them.
integration.missing: Without the Energy Manager integration this card only shows the surplus — loads are created and switched there.
